name: aria-reasoning-logical-consistency
description: Evaluates logical consistency across ARIA's reasoning process.

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: Mostly consistent; one minor logical imprecision.

numerical.label: OK
numerical.definition: Partial inconsistency that doesn't affect the outcome.

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Notable logical contradiction that undermines the response.

numerical.label: Very Poor
numerical.definition: Fundamental logical inconsistency — conclusion contradicts premises.
